transactions.document_locator: Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements, Note 3 'Intangible Asset'
transactions.checked_quote: During 2007, the Company acquired 24 domain names including “fund.com” and one trademark for a total cost of $9,999,950.

additional_sources.source_name: Fund.com Inc. (Eastern Services Holdings) Form 8-K Ex. 99(a)
additional_sources.checked_quote: The Company acquired the domain name “fund.com“ and other intangible assets related to intellectual property and trademarks for a total cost of $9,999,950.
As of December 31, 2009, the Company tested the intangible assets for impairment under ASC 360-10-35-21 and determined that an impairment charge of $1,794,500 was necessary.

leads.note: Trade-press coverage attributing ~$10M to fund.com alone; not reviewed.

valuation_caveats: The $9,999,950 bought 24 domain names and one trademark; no allocation to fund.com is disclosed, so the total must not be attributed to fund.com.
Trade press widely reported the figure as a ~$10M fund.com sale and questioned whether it reflected an arm's-length market price (economic valuation disputed).
The buyer recorded a $1,794,500 impairment on these intangibles at December 31, 2009.
transactions.verification_basis: Buyer's amended Q1 2009 10-Q, Note 3, read in raw text: in 2007 the company acquired 24 domain names including fund.com and one trademark for a total of $9,999,950. Verifies a bundle purchase. It does not establish fund.com's own price.
